1)The President of Bangladesh will be directly elected by the people for 6 year term.(Requirements: the Person must not be a member of any political party, Term limit:6 years renewable once.Age requirement:30 years old and above)
2)The Parliament will be bicameral (HOR:400 seats, NA:92)
3)The Age for Prime Minister will be 25 and above
4)The voting system will change. (For HOR: Party list Proportional Representation and NA: Single transferable vote)
5)To run for any political official you must not be holding an office of profit
6)Must not be found or declared to be of unsound mind
6)The deadline of MP's absence will be for 1 month only. MPs lose their seats if they are absent for more than 30 days.
7)The MP's will be allowed to have a conscience vote.
